title: Observable Performance Does Not Fully Reflect Adaptive System Organization: A Multi-Level Analysis of Gait Dynamics Under Occlusal Constraint
abstract: arXiv:2605.00778v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In biomechanical systems, observable performance is often used as a proxy for underlying organization, although similar outputs may arise from different adaptive configurations. This study considers the vertical dimension of occlusion (VDO) as a constraint applied to an adaptive neuromechanical system. A single-case design in a patient with Parkinson's disease enabled repeated intra-individual gait observations under six occlusal probes. Three complementary analytical levels were examined: (i) an aggregated scalar score of observable performance, (ii) a conceptual dynamical systems framework, and (iii) an exploratory UMAP representation of 55 standardized biomechanical variables from 270 M1 observations. translated_title: 可观测表现并不能完全反映适应性系统的组织结构：咬合约束下步态动力学的多层次分析
translated_abstract: 在生物力学系统中，可观测表现常被用作底层组织结构的替代指标，然而相似的输出可能源于不同的适应性配置。本研究将咬合垂直距离（VDO）视为施加于适应性神经力学系统的一种约束。针对一名帕金森病患者的单病例设计，使得在六种咬合探针条件下进行重复的个体内步态观察成为可能。研究考察了三个互补的分析层次：（i）可观测表现的聚合标量评分；（ii）概念性动力学系统框架；（iii）对来自270次M1观察的55个标准化生物力学变量的探索性UMAP表示。修订后的层次1分析表明，OC2.5与OC3的相对排名取决于评分的构建方式，而其标量分布仍然接近。层次3嵌入显示所有六种探针条件之间存在大量重叠……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对一名帕金森病患者在六种咬合约束下步态动力学的多层次分析，证明可观测的运动表现并不能完全反映适应性神经力学系统的内部组织结构，相似的表观输出可能源于不同的适应性配置。
en_tdlr: Through a multi-level analysis of gait dynamics in a Parkinson's patient under six occlusal constraints, this study demonstrates that observable performance does not fully reflect the underlying organization of an adaptive neuromechanical system, as similar outputs may arise from different adaptive configurations.
